name: Tower AC units
description: Free-standing cooling solutions suitable for compact spaces where a wall or ceiling unit is not preferred.
long_description: Tower ACs stand on the floor and push a strong, long-throw air stream. That makes them useful where walls are glazed, ceilings are high, or a quick setup is needed without false-ceiling work. They pair with an outdoor unit like a split AC and are often used in shops, waiting areas and halls that need fast pull-down cooling.
features: Powerful long-throw airflow for quick cooling
No wall or ceiling mounting needed
Simple installation and easy to relocate
Good for glass-fronted shops and high-ceiling rooms

specs.label: Air throw
specs.value: Long throw, up to about 15 m on larger models

specs.label: Compressor
specs.value: Rotary or scroll; inverter models available

specs.label: Power supply
specs.value: Single phase up to ~2 TR; three phase for larger models

variants.suits: Shops and halls of about 200 – 280 sq ft
Large halls of about 400 – 550 sq ft

considerations: Needs a clear floor spot with an unobstructed air path
Best where a wall or ceiling unit isn't practical
Floor footprint is roughly 0.3 m × 0.5 m

faqs.question: Can a tower AC be moved later?
faqs.answer: Yes. It needs a refrigerant pump-down and re-piping, which is quicker than relocating a ceiling unit.

faqs.question: Is a tower AC good for a high-ceiling hall?
faqs.answer: Yes. Its long, low air throw cools the occupied zone first instead of the space under the roof.
